# AI Safety Council

> The AI Safety Council is an independent, global professional certification authority advancing the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence in Occupational Health, Safety, Environment and Risk Management (AI-OSH). It develops competency-based professional certifications, publishes standards and frameworks, and provides secure online verification of credentials trusted by employers worldwide.

Key facts:
- Type: Independent, vendor-neutral professional body / certification authority
- Focus: Safe and responsible use of AI in occupational health, safety, environment (HSE) and risk management
- Certifications are competency-based (not attendance-based) and CPD accredited
- Global Headquarters: 1250 Bayhill Drive, Suite 315, San Bruno, CA 94066, USA
- Contact: info@aisafetycouncil.co.uk · WhatsApp/Phone +91 82813 36937

## Certification Programs

All programs are at Professional level and CPD accredited.

- **AISP® — Certified AI Safety Professional**: For AI-in-safety practitioners responsible for implementing AI-driven solutions in safety-critical environments.
- **AIRP® — Certified AI Risk Management Professional**: For professionals managing AI risks, controls and assurance programs.
- **AIIP® — Certified AI Incident Investigator Professional**: For professionals investigating AI-related incidents, failures and near-misses.

## Common questions

- **What is the AI Safety Council?** A global professional body that certifies individuals in the safe and responsible use of AI across occupational health, safety, environment and risk.
- **What certifications does it offer?** AISP (Safety), AIRP (Risk Management) and AIIP (Incident Investigator) — all at Professional level.
- **How are credentials verified?** Employers can verify any AI Safety Council credential instantly and securely via the online verification tool.
- **Who is certification for?** Safety, HSE and risk professionals, engineers, analysts and consultants working with AI in operational and safety-critical settings.
